tasks.description: Add a light/dark theme toggle control in the application's Settings page. Toggling it immediately switches the active theme. The toggle should be accessible and follow the existing design tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the Settings page, when the theme toggle is clicked, then the active theme is updated.

tasks.description: Persist the user's selected theme to localStorage so the same theme is applied automatically on the user's next visit. This should handle cases where the user has no stored preference.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user closes and reopens the application, then the previously selected theme is applied.

tasks.description: On the first load, when the user has no stored preference, honor the operating system setting via the prefers-color-scheme media query to choose the initial theme.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has no stored theme preference, when the application is loaded, then the theme is set based on the operating system's preferred color scheme.

tasks.description: Apply the active theme consistently to all pages and shared components of the application. This should use the existing design tokens to ensure a consistent experience.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user navigates to any page or component, then the selected theme is applied consistently.

tasks.description: Write comprehensive tests to ensure the theme toggle, persistence, and application work as expected across different scenarios and user interactions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the theme tests, when they are run, then all tests pass without errors.
